- `/megabit/ticket.md` — asks for a public `interpreter_abi` helper in the tags module, next to `interpreter_name`/`interpreter_version`, returning the same ABI text that appears in a full tag; CPython = name+version joined, other interpreters = derived from the extension suffix; plus a docs entry and a test covering CPython and PyPy.

It carries `.. versionadded:: 26.4`, matching the `.. versionadded:: 26.1` style used at line 1052. Nothing was removed or changed in existing helpers.
- `/workspace/docs/tags.rst` — `.. autofunction:: interpreter_abi` added at line 87, right after `interpreter_version` (line 84) and before `mac_platforms`, i.e. the same list style as its neighbours.
